children: Apple Hospitality REIT made an updated investor presentation available, highlighting October comparable hotel RevPAR growth of approximately 10% and third-quarter operating gains.
The presentation reports third-quarter comparable hotel RevPAR rose 7.3% year over year, while adjusted hotel EBITDA margin expanded 210 basis points to 37.1%.
Third-quarter comparable hotel revenue increased 8.2% to $393.6 million; modified funds from operations per share advanced 16.3% to $0.50.
Five hotels were under contract for sale at a combined gross price of $71.8 million, supporting the company’s portfolio capital-allocation activity.
At September 30, the company reported 28% net debt to total capitalization and no significant debt maturities until 2029.
